title: Gluing derived objects along a continuous ordinal open cover
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\lambda$ be a set-sized ordinal, and let $(W_\alpha)_{\alpha<\lambda}$ be an increasing family of open subsets with $X=\bigcup_{\alpha<\lambda}W_\alpha$ and $W_\alpha=\bigcup_{\beta<\alpha}W_\beta$ at every non-successor ordinal $\alpha<\lambda$ (in particular $W_0=\varnothing$ when $\lambda>0$). Suppose $K_\alpha\in D(\mathcal O_{W_\alpha})$ [def-pc-derived-category] and $\operatorname{Hom}(K_\alpha,K_\alpha[i])=0$ for every integer $i<0$. Suppose isomorphisms $r_\beta^\alpha:K_\alpha|_{W_\beta}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_\beta$ are given for all $\beta<\alpha<\lambda$ and satisfy $r_\gamma^\alpha=r_\gamma^\beta\circ(r_\beta^\alpha|_{W_\gamma})$ for $\gamma<\beta<\alpha$. Then there are $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and isomorphisms $r_\alpha:K|_{W_\alpha}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_\alpha$ such that $r_\beta^\alpha\circ(r_\alpha|_{W_\beta})=r_\beta$ for all $\beta<\alpha<\lambda$.
